name: Blooprint
noteEs: Uno de los canales más sólidos para base building tutorials en 2026. Cubre desde 2x1 starter bases hasta clan compounds con honeycomb, peek-holes, electricity setups y raid defenses. También hace base reviews de la community y raid strategy breakdowns. Si buscas aprender a construir bases serias, Blooprint es la entrada estándar.
noteEn: One of the most solid channels for base building tutorials in 2026. Covers from 2x1 starter bases to clan compounds with honeycomb, peek-holes, electricity setups, and raid defenses. Also does community base reviews and raid strategy breakdowns. If you want to learn to build serious bases, Blooprint is the standard entry.
highlightsEs: Base build tutorials por tamaño de grupo (solo, duo, trio, clan)
Raid strategy breakdowns con annotation de costos y rutas óptimas
Updates de meta de base building después de cada force wipe relevante
highlightsEn: Base build tutorials by group size (solo, duo, trio, clan)
Raid strategy breakdowns with annotation of costs and optimal routes
Base-building meta updates after every relevant force wipe
